notes.title: v1.2 Update
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751171/1fe3b67c3e48b92f6c4ba617d8d9706a36de2dec.jpg"][/img][b]

Update 1.2[/b] is live!

This update adds a couple requested features, quality-of-life improvements, and some cleanup behind the scenes.[/p][p align="start"][b]**What's new:**[/b][/p][p align="start"]- The addition of an instant-restart hotkey for speedrunners!  [i]You can set the binding in the control setup[/i][/p][p align="start"]- You can now add lava to your custom levels![/p]

notes.title: v1.1 Update
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751171/1fe3b67c3e48b92f6c4ba617d8d9706a36de2dec.jpg"][/img][/p][p]\[b]Update 1.1\[/b] is live! 

This update adds a few requested features, quality-of-life improvements, and some cleanup behind the scenes.[/p][p]\[b]**What's new:**\[/b][/p][p]- You can now jump during a dash[/p][p]- You can now jump after falling off a ledge[/p][p]- Level timer now stops immediately when you enter a door in Story Mode[/p][p]- Music will now shift mid-level if you're taking too long[/p][p]- Masks now show which season they unlock in[/p][p]- Cutscenes now auto-advance[/p][p]- Fixed an issue with selecting random mask[/p][p]- Updated resolution settings for better compatibility[/p][p]- Removed some cheaters from the leaderboards[/p]
